svg.text: 4-pole 5-way super switch · push-pull volume · plain tone · RWRP pickup pair — ten voices, eight hum-cancelling
DPDT push-pull — DOWN = series, UP = parallel
GROUND BUSS — star point at the VOLUME pot casing. Both pickup shields, both pot casings, jack sleeve, selector pole 4 and DPDT A3 all land here.
Crossing wires are NOT connected unless a solid junction dot is shown.
